camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem ListImportedLogsByProd --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --ProdCode qcloud_waf --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the log onboarding details for a product
description_zh: 查看该产品下日志接入详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-imported-logs-by-prod --prod-code qcloud_waf --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImportedLogsByProd

parameters.help_en:
The multi-cloud code. Valid values:
hcloud: Huawei Cloud.
qcloud: Tencent Cloud.
aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: View of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: View of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
